	public class AcsIOReal
	{
		public IAdbTop Top { get; set; }

		public IAdbRecord Record { get; set; }

		public string _guid { get; set; }

		public double? Calculated
		{
			get
			{
				return (double?)Record.Value(new object[2] { _guid, "Calculated" });
			}
			set
			{
				Record.SetValue(new object[2] { _guid, "Calculated" }, value);
			}
		}

		public double? Input
		{
			get
			{
				return (double?)Record.Value(new object[2] { _guid, "Input" });
			}
			set
			{
				Record.SetValue(new object[2] { _guid, "Input" }, value);
			}
		}

		public double? Value
		{
			get
			{
				string units;
				return (double?)Record.ScalarValue(_guid, out units);
			}
			set
			{
				Record.SetScalarValue(_guid, value);
			}
		}
	}

		{
			T val = new T();
			if (CanCastTo(val.ClassGuid))
			{
				val.Record = base.Record;
			}
			else
			{
				val = null;
			}
			return val;
		}

	public delegate void AcsNotifyTarget(IAcsNotificationHolder notification);
	public class AcsNotifyRequest : IDisposable
	{
		private string _key;

		private IAdbTopNotify _topRecord;

		private event AcsNotifyTarget _target;

		public AcsNotifyRequest(IAdbTop top, AcsNotifyTarget notificationTarget)
		{
			_topRecord = top as IAdbTopNotify;
			if (_topRecord != null)
			{
				_key = _topRecord.NotifyRequest(OnNotify);
				this._target = notificationTarget;
			}
		}

		public void AddNotify(AcsBaseRecord record, object notifyTag)
		{
			if (_key != null)
			{
				_topRecord.AddNotify(_key, record.Record, notifyTag);
			}
		}

		private void OnNotify(IAdbNotificationHolder notification)
		{
			if (this._target != null)
			{
				this._target(new AcsNotificationHolder(notification));
			}
		}

		void IDisposable.Dispose()
		{
			Dispose(disposing: true);
		}

		protected void Dispose(bool disposing)
		{
			if (disposing)
			{
				_topRecord.UnNotifyRequest(_key);
				_topRecord = null;
				this._target = null;
			}
		}
	}
	public interface IAcsNotificationHolder
	{
		int NotificationCount { get; }

		IEnumerable<IAcsNotification> Notifications { get; }
	}
	public class AcsNotificationHolder : IAcsNotificationHolder
	{
		private IAdbNotificationHolder _holder;

		private List<IAcsNotification> _notifies;

		public int NotificationCount
		{
			get
			{
				if (_holder != null)
				{
					return _holder.NotificationCount;
				}
				return 0;
			}
		}

		public IEnumerable<IAcsNotification> Notifications
		{
			get
			{
				if (_holder == null)
				{
					return null;
				}
				if (_notifies == null)
				{
					_notifies = new List<IAcsNotification>();
					foreach (IAdbNotification notification in _holder.Notifications)
					{
						_notifies.Add(new AcsNotification(notification));
					}
				}
				return _notifies;
			}
		}

		public AcsNotificationHolder(IAdbNotificationHolder holder)
		{
			_holder = holder;
		}
	}
	public interface IAcsNotification
	{
		AcsBaseRecord Record { get; }

		IAcsChange Change { get; }

		object notifyTag { get; }
	}
	public enum AcsChangeType
	{
		Unknown,
		ValueChange,
		ArrayAppend,
		ArrayInsertBefore,
		ArraySetValue,
		ArraySetId,
		ArrayRemove,
		RecordDelete
	}
	public class AcsNotification : IAcsNotification
	{
		public AcsBaseRecord Record { get; private set; }

		public IAcsChange Change { get; private set; }

		public object notifyTag { get; private set; }

		public AcsNotification(IAdbNotification source)
		{
			Record = new AcsBaseRecord
			{
				Top = source.Top,
				Record = source.Record
			};
			Change = new AcsChange(source.Change);
			notifyTag = source.notifyTag;
		}
	}
	public interface IAcsChange
	{
		string VariableName { get; }

		Guid VariableGuid { get; }

		AcsChangeType changeType { get; }

		int currentLocation { get; }

		string Description { get; }
	}
	public class AcsChange : IAcsChange
	{
		private IAdbChange _source;

		public string VariableName
		{
			get
			{
				if (_source != null)
				{
					return _source.VariableName;
				}
				return null;
			}
		}

		public Guid VariableGuid
		{
			get
			{
				if (_source != null)
				{
					return _source.VariableGuid;
				}
				return Guid.Empty;
			}
		}

		public AcsChangeType changeType
		{
			get
			{
				if (_source != null)
				{
					return (AcsChangeType)_source.changeType;
				}
				return AcsChangeType.Unknown;
			}
		}

		public int currentLocation
		{
			get
			{
				if (_source != null)
				{
					return _source.currentLocation;
				}
				return -1;
			}
		}

		public string Description
		{
			get
			{
				if (_source != null)
				{
					return _source.Description;
				}
				return null;
			}
		}

		public AcsChange(IAdbChange source)
		{
			_source = source;
		}
	}
	public class AcsEnum<T> : IEnumerable<T>, IEnumerable where T : AcsBase, new()
	{
		public IAdbTop top { get; set; }

		public string guidString { get; set; }

		public IEnumerator<T> GetEnumerator()
		{
			if (top is IAdbEnumerable adbEnumerable)
			{
				IEnumerator<IAdbRecord> en = adbEnumerable.GetRecordEnumerator(guidString);
				while (en.MoveNext())
				{
					yield return new T
					{
						Record = en.Current
					};
				}
			}
		}

		IEnumerator IEnumerable.GetEnumerator()
		{
			return GetEnumerator();
		}
	}

	public class AcsCompressorExpanderCurve : AcsPumpCurve
	{
		public new static string myGuid = "647F0B73-C625-4859-B403-6A36CFC1947A";

		protected static string ActiveGuid = "204f3a96-6973-47e5-a189-300953c294de";

		public override string ClassGuid => myGuid;

		public bool Active
		{
			get
			{
				string units;
				return (bool)base.Record.ScalarValue(ActiveGuid, out units);
			}
			set
			{
				base.Record.SetScalarValue(ActiveGuid, value);
			}
		}

		public AcsCompressorExpanderCurve()
		{
			InitializeArrays();
		}

			InitializeArrays();
		}

		}

		{
			base.Record = record;
			InitializeArrays();
		}

		public AcsTraySectionResultData(IAdbTop top)
		{
			base.Top = top;
			base.Record = top.CreateRecord(myGuid);
			InitializeArrays();
		}

		protected new void InitializeArrays()
		{
			base.InitializeArrays();
			StageProfile = new ReferenceArray<AcsNoId, AcsStageProfilePoint>
			{
				Guid = StageProfileGuid,
				Container = this
			};
		}

		public AcsAPRCSTR()
		{
			InitializeArrays();
		}

		public AcsAPRCSTR(IAdbRecord record)
		{
			base.Record = record;
			InitializeArrays();
		}

		public AcsAPRCSTR(IAdbTop top)
		{
			base.Top = top;
			base.Record = top.CreateRecord(myGuid);
			InitializeArrays();
		}

		protected new void InitializeArrays()

			base.Record = record;
			InitializeArrays();
		}

		{
			base.Top = top;
			base.Record = top.CreateRecord(myGuid);
			InitializeArrays();
		}

		{
			base.InitializeArrays();
			EquilibriumConstants = new ValueArray<string, double>
			{
				Guid = EquilibriumConstantsGuid,
				Container = this
			};
			EquilibriumTemperature = new ValueArray<string, double>
			{
				Guid = EquilibriumTemperatureGuid,
				Container = this
			};
		}

	public class AcsHierarchy : AcsUoBlock
	{
		public new static string myGuid = "FCFA3552-FDA5-43F7-86A3-93CA8F094BC2";

		protected static string InternalInletsGuid = "2f2b54f5-0fe0-47a7-a90a-70da617a58da";

		protected static string InternalOutletsGuid = "3bfc4754-a448-47d1-82bf-a9a246075901";

		public IDRfReferenceArray<AcsConnection, AcsStream> InternalInlets;

		public IDRfReferenceArray<AcsConnection, AcsStream> InternalOutlets;

		public override string ClassGuid => myGuid;

		public AcsHierarchy()
		{
			InitializeArrays();
		}

		public AcsHierarchy(IAdbRecord record)
		{
			base.Record = record;
			InitializeArrays();
		}

		public AcsHierarchy(IAdbTop top)
		{
			base.Top = top;
			base.Record = top.CreateRecord(myGuid);
			InitializeArrays();
		}

		protected new void InitializeArrays()
		{
			base.InitializeArrays();
			InternalInlets = new IDRfReferenceArray<AcsConnection, AcsStream>
			{
				Guid = InternalInletsGuid,
				Container = this
			};
			InternalOutlets = new IDRfReferenceArray<AcsConnection, AcsStream>
			{
				Guid = InternalOutletsGuid,
				Container = this
			};
		}

		public void ConnectInternalInlet(AcsStream extstream, AcsStream intstream)
		{
			base.Record.Execute("cba26046-8246-4e91-bc78-b45bb5851e7c", new object[2]
			{
				extstream?.Record,
				intstream?.Record
			});
		}

		public void ConnectInternalOutlet(AcsStream extstream, AcsStream intstream)
		{
			base.Record.Execute("e8c661b7-51bd-4c91-a7cc-7501ddd0c422", new object[2]
			{
				extstream?.Record,
				intstream?.Record
			});
		}

		public void DisconnectInternalInlet(AcsStream extstream)
		{
			base.Record.Execute("42b21bc2-ba71-4e21-b9ad-99c5e873ed5d", new object[1] { extstream?.Record });
		}

		public void DisconnectInternalOutlet(AcsStream extstream)
		{
			base.Record.Execute("30858878-ac8b-4c8d-aa85-63b1914e07af", new object[1] { extstream?.Record });
		}
	}

		public AcsStream()
		{
			InitializeArrays();
		}

		public AcsStream(IAdbRecord record)
		{
			base.Record = record;
			InitializeArrays();
		}

		public AcsStream(IAdbTop top)
		{
			base.Top = top;
			base.Record = top.CreateRecord(myGuid);
			InitializeArrays();
		}

		protected new void InitializeArrays()
		{
			base.InitializeArrays();
			Substreams = new ReferenceArray<string, AcsSubstream>
			{
				Guid = SubstreamsGuid,
				Container = this
			};
			AbeStreamClasses = new ValueArray<int, string>
			{
				Guid = AbeStreamClassesGuid,
				Container = this
			};
		}

		public string FullPath(string delimeter)
		{
			return (string)base.Record.Execute("f28f1a93-a267-418b-b096-b2ecda8a0dcd", new object[1] { delimeter });
		}

		public void DeleteOutput()
		{
			base.Record.Execute("0eba1da8-0dcc-49da-b434-c7b7e97cfa54", null);
		}

		public void DeleteSelectedOutput(int mask)
		{
			base.Record.Execute("e8b69b7c-2c42-4656-b27c-4877d0188164", new object[1] { mask });
		}

		}

		protected new void InitializeArrays()
		{
			base.InitializeArrays();
		}
	}

namespace AspenTech.Adb.AdsAccessor
{
	public class Accessor : IAccessor, IDisposable
	{
		protected class ArrayBaseHolder
		{
			public AcsArrayBase arrayBase { get; set; }

			public Type arrayType { get; set; }
		}

		private IAdbTop _top;

		private string _filename;

		public bool IsOpen => _top != null;

		public Accessor()
		{
		}

		public Accessor(IAdbTop adbTop)
		{
			_top = adbTop;
		}

		public bool Attach(IAdbTop adbTop)
		{
			_top = adbTop;
			return true;
		}

		public bool Open(string filename)
		{
			bool flag = false;
			if (IsOpen)
			{
				_top = null;
				_filename = null;
			}
			IAdbManager adbManager = AcsFactory.Manager();
			_top = adbManager.OpenDatabase(filename, createIfNecessary: false);
			Console.WriteLine(Directory.GetCurrentDirectory());
			if (_top != null)
			{
				flag = true;
				_filename = filename;
			}
			else
			{
				flag = false;
			}
			return flag;
		}

		protected AccessorElement GetVariableChild(AcsBase parent, string parentPath, string idstr, int location)
		{
			AccessorElement accessorElement = new AccessorElement();
			try
			{
				if (location == -1)
				{
					location = parent.LocationOfID(idstr);
					if (location == -1)
					{
						accessorElement.success = false;
						accessorElement.errormsg = "Variable: \"" + idstr + "\" does not exist";
					}
				}
				else
				{
					idstr = parent.IDAtLocation(location);
					if (idstr == null)
					{
						accessorElement.success = false;
						accessorElement.errormsg = "Location " + location + "is out of range.  Maximum is " + parent.NumberOfVariables();
					}
				}
				if (location != -1 && idstr != null)
				{
					string text = parent.GuidAtLocation(location);
					object obj = parent.ValueAtLocation(location);
					int unitrow = parent.UnitRow(text);
					Type type = null;
					if (obj != null)
					{
						type = obj.GetType();
					}
					else
					{
						type = parent.TypeAtLocation(location) as Type;
						if (type != null && Nullable.GetUnderlyingType(type) != null)
						{
							type = null;
						}
					}
					if (type != null && type.IsGenericType)
					{
						accessorElement.value = new ArrayBaseHolder
						{
							arrayBase = new AcsArrayBase
							{
								Container = parent,
								Guid = text
							},
							arrayType = type
						};
					}
					else if (obj is IAdbRecord adbRecord)
					{
						accessorElement.value = new AcsBase(adbRecord);
						accessorElement.objectGuid = adbRecord.RecordGuid();
					}
					else
					{
						accessorElement.value = obj;
					}
					accessorElement.unitrow = unitrow;
					accessorElement.attribute = idstr;
					accessorElement.variableGuid = text;
					accessorElement.type = type;
					accessorElement.success = true;
					accessorElement.cxsPath = parentPath + "." + idstr;
				}
			}
			catch (Exception ex)
			{
				accessorElement.success = false;
				accessorElement.errormsg = ex.Message;
			}
			return accessorElement;
		}

		protected AcsComponent Component(string possibleComponentName)
		{
			return new AcsTopRecord(_top).ComponentList.Components.ValueAt(possibleComponentName);
		}

		protected AccessorElement FindChild(AccessorElement node, object id)
		{
			AccessorElement accessorElement = new AccessorElement();
			try
			{
				if (node.value != null)
				{
					node.GetType();
					id.GetType();
					int num = -1;
					string text = id as string;
					string text2 = id as string;
					if (text != null && text.StartsWith("#"))
					{
						try
						{
							num = int.Parse(text.Substring(1));
						}
						catch
						{
							num = -1;
						}
					}
					if (node.value is AcsBase parent)
					{
						accessorElement = GetVariableChild(parent, node.cxsPath, text, num);
					}
					else if (node.value is ArrayBaseHolder { arrayBase: var arrayBase } arrayBaseHolder)
					{
						if (num != -1)
						{
							int length = arrayBase.Length;
							if (num < -1 || num >= length)
							{
								accessorElement.success = false;
								accessorElement.errormsg = "Location: " + num + " is out of range.  Maximum is " + length;
							}
							else
							{
								accessorElement.unitrow = node.unitrow;
								accessorElement.value = arrayBase.ObjectValueAtLocation(num);
								int? num2 = arrayBase.UnitRowAtLocation(num) as int?;
								if ((num2 ?? 0) != 0)
								{
									accessorElement.unitrow = num2.Value;
								}
								accessorElement.type = accessorElement.value.GetType();
								accessorElement.success = true;
								object obj2 = arrayBase.ObjectIDAtLocation(num);
								IAdbRecord adbRecord = accessorElement.value as IAdbRecord;
								if (obj2 != null)
								{
									accessorElement.attribute = obj2.ToString();
									if (obj2 != null && obj2.GetType().ToString().Contains("AdbComponent"))
									{
										AcsComponent acsComponent = new AcsComponent((IAdbRecord)obj2);
										accessorElement.attribute = acsComponent.ID;
									}
								}
								else
								{
									accessorElement.attribute = "#" + num;
								}
								accessorElement.cxsPath = node.cxsPath + "." + accessorElement.attribute;
								if (adbRecord != null)
								{
									accessorElement.value = new AcsBase(adbRecord);
									accessorElement.objectGuid = adbRecord.RecordGuid();
								}
							}
						}
						else
						{
							if (text != null)
							{
								Type type = arrayBaseHolder.arrayType.GetGenericArguments()[0];
								if (type != typeof(string) && type != typeof(string))
								{
									try
									{
										AcsComponent acsComponent2 = Component(text);
										if (acsComponent2 != null)
										{
											id = acsComponent2.Record;
										}
									}
									catch (Exception)
									{
									}
								}
							}
							num = arrayBase.FindObjectID(id);
							if (num == -1)
							{
								accessorElement.success = false;
								accessorElement.errormsg = "Element: \"" + ((text == null) ? id.ToString() : text) + "\" does not exist";
							}
							else
							{
								accessorElement.unitrow = node.unitrow;
								accessorElement.value = arrayBase.ObjectValueAtLocation(num);
								int? num3 = arrayBase.UnitRowAtLocation(num) as int?;
								if ((num3 ?? 0) != 0)
								{
									accessorElement.unitrow = num3.Value;
								}
								accessorElement.attribute = text;
								accessorElement.type = accessorElement.value.GetType();
								accessorElement.success = true;
								accessorElement.cxsPath = node.cxsPath + "." + text2;
								if (accessorElement.value is IAdbRecord record)
								{
									accessorElement.value = new AcsBase(record);
								}
							}
						}
					}
					else
					{
						accessorElement.success = false;
						accessorElement.errormsg = "Invalid object of type: " + node.GetType().ToString();
					}
				}
				else
				{
					accessorElement.errormsg = "Null object being searched.";
				}
			}
			catch (Exception ex2)
			{
				accessorElement.success = false;
				accessorElement.errormsg = ex2.Message;
			}
			return accessorElement;
		}

		public AccessorElement ObjectAt(AccessorElement start, IEnumerable<object> path)
		{
			AccessorElement accessorElement = new AccessorElement();
			if (_top == null)
			{
				accessorElement.success = false;
				accessorElement.errormsg = "File not open";
			}
			else
			{
				AccessorElement accessorElement2 = start;
				if (accessorElement2 == null)
				{
					accessorElement2 = new AccessorElement
					{
						value = new AcsTopRecord(_top),
						cxsPath = "appModel.SharedData"
					};
				}
				string text = "[start]";
				bool flag = false;
				foreach (object item in path)
				{
					if (accessorElement2.value == null)
					{
						accessorElement.success = false;
						accessorElement.errormsg = "Null node at path: \"" + text + "\"";
						flag = true;
						break;
					}
					AccessorElement accessorElement3 = FindChild(accessorElement2, item);
					if (accessorElement3.errormsg != null)
					{
						accessorElement.success = false;
						accessorElement.errormsg = "Failed to find child \"" + item.ToString() + "\" at path: \"" + text + "\". Reason: " + accessorElement3.errormsg;
						flag = true;
						break;
					}
					accessorElement2 = accessorElement3;
					text += ".";
					text += item.ToString();
				}
				if (!flag)
				{
					accessorElement = accessorElement2;
				}
			}
			return accessorElement;
		}

		public AccessorElement ObjectAtPath(AccessorElement start, string path)
		{
			if (path.StartsWith("'") && path.Length > 1 && path.EndsWith("'"))
			{
				return ObjectAt(start, new string[1] { path.Substring(1, path.Length - 2) });
			}
			string[] path2 = path.Split('.');
			return ObjectAt(start, path2);
		}

		public int NumberOfChildren(AccessorElement node)
		{
			int result = 0;
			try
			{
				if (_top != null)
				{
					if (node == null)
					{
						node = new AccessorElement
						{
							value = new AcsTopRecord(_top),
							cxsPath = "appModel.SharedData"
						};
					}
					if (node.value is AcsBase acsBase)
					{
						result = acsBase.NumberOfVariables();
					}
					else if (node.value is ArrayBaseHolder arrayBaseHolder)
					{
						result = arrayBaseHolder.arrayBase.Length;
					}
				}
			}
			catch
			{
			}
			return result;
		}

		public IEnumerable<AccessorElement> Children(AccessorElement node)
		{
			if (_top != null)
			{
				if (node == null)
				{
					node = new AccessorElement
					{
						value = new AcsTopRecord(_top),
						cxsPath = "appModel.SharedData"
					};
				}
				int length = NumberOfChildren(node);
				for (int i = 0; i < length; i++)
				{
					yield return FindChild(node, "#" + i);
				}
			}
		}

		public void Dispose()
		{
			Dispose(disposing: true);
			GC.SuppressFinalize(this);
		}

		protected virtual void Dispose(bool disposing)
		{
			if (disposing)
			{
				_top = null;
			}
		}

		public void Lock()
		{
			if (_top != null)
			{
				new AcsTopRecord(_top).TakeMutex();
			}
		}

		public void Unlock()
		{
			if (_top != null)
			{
				new AcsTopRecord(_top).ReleaseMutex();
			}
		}
	}
	public class AccessorElement
	{
		public bool success { get; set; }

		public string errormsg { get; set; }

		public string attribute { get; set; }

		public string variableGuid { get; set; }

		public string objectGuid { get; set; }

		public object value { get; set; }

		public Type type { get; set; }

		public int unitrow { get; set; }

		public string cxsPath { get; set; }

		public AccessorElement()
		{
			success = true;
			errormsg = null;
			attribute = null;
			variableGuid = null;
			objectGuid = null;
			value = null;
			type = null;
			unitrow = 0;
			cxsPath = null;
		}

		public object InvokeMethod(string methodName, params object[] parameters)
		{
			if (value is AcsBase acsBase)
			{
				int num = acsBase.LocationOfID(methodName);
				if (num != -1)
				{
					string guid = acsBase.GuidAtLocation(num);
					return acsBase.Record.Execute(guid, parameters);
				}
				MethodInfo method = acsBase.Record.GetType().GetMethod(methodName);
				if (method != null)
				{
					return method.Invoke(acsBase.Record, parameters);
				}
			}
			if (value != null)
			{
				MethodInfo method2 = value.GetType().GetMethod(methodName);
				if (method2 != null)
				{
					return method2.Invoke(value, parameters);
				}
			}
			throw new InvalidOperationException("methodName");
		}
	}
	public interface IAccessor
	{
		bool IsOpen { get; }

		bool Open(string filename);

		bool Attach(IAdbTop adbTop);

		AccessorElement ObjectAt(AccessorElement start, IEnumerable<object> path);

		AccessorElement ObjectAtPath(AccessorElement start, string path);

		int NumberOfChildren(AccessorElement node);

		IEnumerable<AccessorElement> Children(AccessorElement node);

		void Lock();

		void Unlock();
	}
}
